items.title: August Lanoix Interview, 1961-04-19
items.q: Well I'd taken bass lessons onto him. He was playing bass at that time. I stayed with him about a year.

ctx.x: Did you try to bow it or pick it in those days? Tried to bow it.

Well, so then I had to learn something about the bass. So I went on to a fellow, he was, at one time, he was a good violin player, you might have heard of him, Wendell McNeil. Oh yes. Well I'd taken bass lessons onto him. He was playing bass at that time. I stayed with him about a year. Then I went out for myself and practiced, from what little I knew about music, from the trombone. Yeah. And that's how I came along. And with him and his brother, we used to practice, like I said, with that trio. The Gabriel trio.…
Is the trombone the player the leader? No, the trumpet player.
